identification: Box of about 16 reference books on antique lace, all visible in photos: Jourdain 'Old Lace' (hardback), Hart-Calvert 'The Love of Lace', Eunice Close 'Lace Making', Gabrielle Pond 'An Introduction to Lace', Preston 'Needle-made Laces and Net Embroideries' (Dover), Pat Earnshaw 'A Dictionary of Lace', Patricia Wardle 'Victorian Lace' (Ruth Bean edition per spine), Jackson 'Old Handmade Lace with a Dictionary of Lace' (Dover), Earnshaw 'Needlelace' (Merehurst), Earnshaw 'Lace in Fashion', Grimwood 'Starting Needlepoint Lace', Earnshaw 'Bobbin & Needle Laces: Identification and Care', Lovesey 'Introduction to Needlepoint Lace' (Batsford), Earnshaw 'Needle-made Laces' (Ward Lock), plus 'Irish Lace' and 'Dress for a Lady' booklets.
